It had rained in Sol for nine years.
So one night, I followed him into the alleys.
He wasn't stopping the rain. He was dodging it.
Every drop. Too fast for the storm to touch him.
So he did. Every night, in the rain.
I held my umbrella. I couldn't dodge yet.
A hundred nights. A thousand drops.
Then one night, I closed it.
Now there are two of us.
